definitions.short: properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural)
definitions.full: H4962. math [ מַת ] noun masculine male, man ( מְתוּֿ in proper name; Zinjirli מת collective males, male offspring ; Assyrian mutu , husband ; Ethiopic id. ; compare Egyptian m-t , phallus, male , Steind in Ba NB § 2b , δ ); — only plural מְתִים Job 11:3 3 t., מְתִם Deut 2:34 ; 3:6 + Judg 20:48 (probably), for מְתֹם ᵑ0 , so GFM; construct מְתֵי Gen 34:30 13 t.; suffix 2 feminine singular מְתַיִךְ ; Isa 3:25 ; 3 masculine singular מְתָיו Deut 33:6 ; — 1 males, men , Isa 3:25 (|| גְּבוּרָתֵךְ ); more distinctly, עִיר מְתִם (וְ)הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף Deut 2:34 ; 3:6 every city of males (male population, compare Dr), and the women , etc.; Judg 20:48 (see above; opposed to בְּהֵמָה ). 2 usually less emphasis on sex, in prose only phrase: a. מִסְמָּר מְתֵי men of number (numerable, i.e. few) Gen 34:30 (J; apposition of אֲנִי = Jacob, representing his family), Deut 4:27 ; Jer 44:28 , also Psa 105:12 = 1Chr 16:19 ; compare מִסְמָּר מְתָיו וִיהִי Deut 33:6 and (but) let his men be few. b. מְעָ֑ט בִּמְתֵי = consisting of a few men Deut 26:5 ; 28:62 3 elsewhere only in poetry, sex usually not emphasized: a. Job 11:3 ; 24:12 ; Psa 17:14 (twice in verse) (but text probably corrupt, of. Bae We; at least omit ידך ממתים Ol Bi Che, compare Hup-Now); ישׂראל מְתֵי Isa 41:14 . b. poetic phrase: שָׁוְא מְתֵי men of false-hood Job 11:11 ; Psa 26:4 ; ׳מ אָוֶן 22:15 men of wickedness ; ׳מ סוֺדִי Psalm 19:19 men of my cycle ; ׳מ אָהֳלִי Job 31:31 men of my tent (household); ׳מ רָעָב Isa 5:13 men of hunger , but read probably ר ׳מְזֵי sucked out, empty from hunger (as Deut 32:24 ) Ew De Che Di Du (compare מָזֶה ).
